title: Apple is making Wallet passes more actionable. For ecommerce, that changes what a pass can do.
summary: Apple’s iOS 27 Wallet updates bring richer design and Featured Actions to passes. Here’s what that means for ecommerce brands using Talkable Wallet.
body_markdown:
Apple’s iOS 27 Wallet updates bring richer design and Featured Actions to passes. For ecommerce brands, that makes Wallet a more useful place to keep rewards, offers, referral access, and the next relevant campaign moment.


## A pass should have a job


Most digital offers disappear where they started: in an inbox, browser tab, or message thread. A Wallet pass works differently. Once a customer adds it, it stays in the place they already use for payment cards, boarding passes, and event tickets. That only matters if the pass earns its place.


Apple’s own design guidance is clear on this point: Wallet passes should be useful, timely, and easy to scan. The best ecommerce pass is not a miniature landing page or another promotional surface. It gives the customer a dependable answer to a real question: What reward do I have? What offer is available? Where do I go next? Can I use this in store?


That is the positioning behind[Talkable Wallet](https://get.talkable.com/wallet-pass) : **mobile wallet passes that customers keep.** Not another coupon. Not another app. A useful piece of customer wallet real estate for live offers, store credit, rewards, campaign access, and the next relevant action.


## What Apple’s iOS 27 update changes


iOS 27 makes Wallet passes more visual and more actionable. For brands, the practical shift is that a pass can do a better job of representing the brand while helping a customer move forward without hunting through email or a logged-in account.


### Poster Generic gives brands a better canvas


Apple’s new Poster Generic pass style supports a fuller visual treatment than traditional pass layouts. That gives brands more room to make a pass recognizable at a glance. The design rule still holds: lead with the useful thing. A reward balance, available credit, member status, or active offer should remain easy to find in live text, not buried in artwork. Apple Watch displays less information and may crop imagery, so essential details cannot live only in the design.


### Featured Actions turn a pass into a next step


Featured Actions make it easier to present a relevant action directly from a pass. With Talkable Wallet, brands can use that action space for campaign paths such as **Refer a friend** , **View your reward** , **Shop now** , or **See offer details** . The action should lead to an experience that can fulfill the promise behind it, with the click and resulting activity connected back to campaign reporting.


### Barcode support helps connect online and in-store moments


Expanded barcode support gives brands more flexibility when an offer, reward, or member identifier needs to work with an existing scanner or point-of-sale flow. That is useful for omnichannel programs, but it is not a shortcut around operations. Teams still need to test eligibility, redemption rules, staff experience, and what happens when a code is expired or already used.


## Talkable makes the Wallet surface campaignable and measurable


Apple provides the place customers keep a pass. Talkable provides the referral, rewards, fraud prevention, and attribution layer behind it.


That distinction matters. A Wallet pass by itself does not drive a referral or prove that it caused a purchase. Talkable Wallet connects the pass to the campaign experience behind it: a referral share path, a reward status, a store-credit moment, an offer, or a route back to shop. Brands can then understand what happened around the pass instead of treating it as a static digital coupon.


## How to design a pass people will keep


Start with a customer moment, not a feature list. A repeat customer may need a quick way to see store credit. A recent advocate may want to check the status of a referral reward. A shopper at a pop-up may need a code that staff can scan. Each is a real job a pass can help with.


- **Lead with live value.** Put the current reward, status, offer, or access point where a customer can scan it quickly.
- **Keep the front uncluttered.** Use the pass as a clear reference point, not a place to stack multiple campaigns and fine print.
- **Use imagery to support, not replace, information.** Preserve accessible text, contrast, and a design that still works on Apple Watch.
- **Make updates genuinely useful.** Apple reserves change messages for time-critical updates, not general promotion. Update a pass when the customer’s benefit or status actually changes.
- **Test the full redemption path.** Check save, refresh, scanner behavior, expired offers, support handoffs, and return visits before broadening access.


## Measure the moments that matter


The pass is one touchpoint in a broader customer journey, so measurement should be specific. Track save attempts and successful saves separately. Understand which actions pass holders take next: referral sharing, reward views, offer detail visits, return-to-shop clicks, and verified redemption where applicable.


Then keep the attribution honest. A pass may be a reminder rather than the only reason a customer acted. The value of Talkable is that it connects the Wallet interaction to the campaign and outcomes behind it, so teams can see patterns without claiming every later purchase came from the pass alone.


### Give customers something worth keeping


Apple is making Wallet more visual and actionable. Talkable Wallet helps ecommerce brands turn that customer surface into a useful, measurable part of referral, rewards, and retention campaigns.

## The new standard is usefulness


Apple’s iOS 27 updates give brands a better canvas and a faster path to the next action. The opportunity is not to get another branded item onto a customer’s phone. It is to earn a place in their Wallet with something that stays useful after the first save.


For ecommerce teams, that means pairing a clean pass with a real customer benefit, a relevant action, and a measurable campaign experience. That is how a Wallet pass becomes more than a digital coupon: it becomes a customer surface worth keeping.
